seoTitle: FilmEditRun | Corporate Video Production Cambridge & London
seoDescription: Independent video production studio and post-house based in Cambridge, filming on-location across London and the UK. Conferences, brand films, and podcasts.
tagline: Independent video production and post-house. We capture conferences, brand stories, and live events on-location across Cambridge, London, and nationwide—delivering polished films that keep audiences engaged.
introBody: Great video isn’t about flashy agency jargon or rigid scripts—it’s about capturing real energy, genuine voices, and clear ideas. Operating from Cambridge with agile crews on-location across London and the UK, we handle everything from multi-stage summit recordings to intimate brand documentaries and rapid post-production.
